name: Zhejiang Dayuan Pumps Industry Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Dayuan Pumps Industry Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of water pumps in China and internationally. The company offers surface pumps; submersible and sewage pumps; multistage submersible pumps; deep well pumps; pool and garden pumps; solar pumps and systems; and commercial pumps. Its products are used in residential, agriculture and irrigation, commercial building, solar pumping solutions, livestock and marine aquaculture, as well as pool and garden. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
